note: RV-only park (no tents) beside the Fort Hays site on the US-16 corridor at the south edge of Rapid City, toward Mount Rushmore. Level gravel full-hookup sites, pull-through and back-in, with fiber internet at each site, a shower house, coin laundry and dog runs. Open year-round; monthly sites are also sold. No wood fires or charcoal. --Claude
